title: SpatialTransformWaveformType
description: A uniformly-sampled time series of 6-DOF poses, represented as parallel position and quaternion arrays (not an array of SpatialTransform), anchored at a start timestamp and sampled at a fixed interval.

positions.description: The uniformly-sampled position values, in chronological order, parallel to quaternions.

quaternions.description: The uniformly-sampled orientation values, in chronological order, parallel to positions.

t0.description: The timestamp of the first sample.

dt.description: The fixed interval between consecutive samples.
